description: Main source code for a Zephyr-based application interfacing with a Maxim DS3231 RTC and counter driver, including time formatting, alarm handling, synchronization, and device initialization.

methods.name: format_time
methods.description: Formats a time_t and nanoseconds into a human-readable string with date, time, day of week, and day of year.

methods.name: sec_counter_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked by the counter when a scheduled event occurs, logs callback details.

methods.name: sec_alarm_handler
methods.description: Handles the alarm event, reads sync clock, updates alarm configuration, and logs status.

methods.name: timespec_subtract
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two timespec structures, normalizing the result.

methods.name: timespec_add
methods.description: Calculates the sum of two timespec structures, normalizing the result.

methods.name: min_alarm_handler
methods.description: Handles the minimum alarm, adjusts RTC sync point based on current time and sync clock, and logs adjustments.

methods.name: show_counter
methods.description: Displays properties of the DS3231 counter device, including max value, channels, frequency, and current time.

methods.name: set_aligned_clock
methods.description: Sets the RTC to the next hour boundary, aligning the device clock with system uptime.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing the DS3231 device, performing synchronization, setting alarms, and running the event loop.
